# Changelog

## v.0.3.10

- Fixed [#142](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/142): Dialog title overriding the 'close' icon
- Fixed [#137](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/137): Badge position is not correctly set
- Fixed [#130](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/130): Improve legend layout with "number of row" selector
- Fixed [#128](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/128): Select component not adapted for forms?

## v.0.3.9

- Fixed: correct little bugs and warning
- Fixed [#135](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/135): Drawer does not close when 'view' property is set to false

## v.0.3.8

- Fixed [#112](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/112): missing onClose property
- Fixed [#110](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/110): Remove margin-bottom
- Added `Label` component
- Fixed [#113](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/113): Property 'disabled' does not exist
- Fixed [#125](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/113): TimePicker appearance weird
- Fixed [#124](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/124): DatePicker appearance different from the documentation
- Fixed [#111](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/111): Add automated scroll behaviour

## v.0.3.7

- [feat] Add SegmentedControl component

## v.0.3.6

- Modify elevation for papper
- Added padding in IconButton
- Fixed [#94](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/94): Badge position is overriding the text/icon
- Fixed [#99](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/99): Component needs to have a prop 'value'
- Fixed [#97](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/97): Property 'className' does not exist
- Modify elevation for papper
- Added padding in IconButton

## v.0.3.5

- Fixed [#97](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/97): Cannot re-open a previously closed Slide
- Fixed [#98](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/98): the slide does not close on timeout
- Fixed [#94](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/94): Badge position is overriding the text/icon
- Added border radius in card
- Decrease space between tab

## v.0.3.4

- Added "top" `Drawer`
- Fixed [#88](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/88): checkbox without label
- Fixed `Typeahead` props typing

## v.0.3.3

- Fixed typing of `Tab`'s `label` prop to allow for badges and other comps.

## v.0.3.2

- Added `label`, `placeholder` and `onChange` props to `Typeahead`;
- Added `className` prop to `Button`;
- Removed ghost `Button` bottom margin;
- Fixed typing of `Button` props to allow `disabled` prop and more;
- Restyled `Radio` and added `RadioGroup`.

## v.0.3.1

- Pinned lib dependencies.

## v.0.3.0

- Fixed bad Stepper behavior ;
- Fixed [#70](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/70): missing `className` prop for `Banner`;
- Fixed [#47](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/47): added `closable` prop to `Banner`.

## v.0.2.1

- Fixed [#65](https://github.airbus.com/Airbus/design-system/issues/65): tabs remained active after swipe;
- Added custom `icon` prop to Tab;
- Removed `Step` and `StepContent` redundant props (`horizontal`, `active`, `done`): they should be setted at the `Stepper` level;
- Fixed `onChange` errors on input components when used in a TS project;
- Added `Menu` component.
